title: General Linear Weil Character Fixed-Point Formula
body_html:
General Linear Weil Character Fixed-Point Formula

Let $k$ have order $q$, and let $g \in G(V) \simeq \operatorname{GL}(V)$. The character of the general linear Weil representation is $$ \operatorname{Tr} W^V(g)=q^{N(V;g)}, \qquad N(V;g)=\dim_k \ker(g-1). $$ Equivalently, this is the square root of the order of the kernel of $g-1$ on $V \times V^\vee$.
